welcome.title: Welcome to ClaudeDeck
welcome.subtitle: Manage several Claude Code accounts from one window, each kept fully separate.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.body: Each account runs as its own Claude Code profile, with its own settings, agents and sign-in.

projects.title: Projects
projects.body: Give each project a folder and an account; tabs opened in that project use that account.

tabs.title: Tabs
tabs.body: Open Claude and terminal tabs side by side in a project and pick up where you left off.

account.title: Create your first account
account.subtitle: Pick a name and a color that make the account easy to recognize.
account.name: Account name

signIn.title: Sign in to {{name}}
signIn.subtitle: Authorizing Claude Code for this account.
signIn.laterHint: You can also sign in later from Settings.

import.title: Bring your Claude setup
import.subtitle: Copy your existing instructions, agents and plugins into this account's profile. The source files are not changed.
import.nothing: There is nothing to import from this source.
import.replaceHint: This account's profile already has content. Previous versions of files that change are backed up before importing.
import.backup: Previous versions were backed up to:

optimize.title: Optimize the profile
optimize.subtitle: Claude can restructure this account's profile following the ClaudeDeck recommended setup.
optimize.intro: In this step your own Claude reviews this account's profile and restructures it with the ClaudeDeck recommended setup.

review.title: Review and restructure
review.body: Instructions, agents and skills are reviewed, with suggestions for duplicated or scattered parts.

approve.title: Approval for every change
approve.body: Claude asks for your permission each time before it changes a file.

backup.title: Backup first
backup.body: Files are backed up before they are edited.

done.title: You are all set
done.subtitle: Your account is ready to use in ClaudeDeck.
done.later: You can run import and optimize again later from the account row in Settings.

profile.title: Profile
profile.hint: Instructions, agents, skills and plugins live in this account's profile.
